output.name: Tharnu — The Thaw Oar
output.myth: In the thaw, when the sea goes grey and the floes grind like teeth, the boats stay tied under the cliffs. Ennu the Kite-Wright sat too long over her cloth one spring and forgot the boats. Orrun felt the ice on his back and rolled, and the floes broke open in a line. Ennu saw the black water and was ashamed. She took a long oar of bone and pushed a boat out through the gap. Tavo came down the wind to laugh at her, and she did not look up. The stroke went on until the ice lay open from the cliffs to the far skerries. She hung the oar in Vel, fifteen degrees west of the Ferry Sail, which she sewed square so the first crossing would tear less. The Mending Shuttle lies fifteen degrees south of it, the better needle Kael asked for when the stars slipped his mesh. Her hands are still on the oar. In spring, watch for the pale line, and mend your own boats.
output.finding: Start at the Ferry Sail (Halan) and go three-quarters of a hand-span (about 15°) due west along the Lamp Road to find the Thaw Oar.
